about: RULES.md 1.4: the performance gate (packaging/dexterity/tests/perf_gate.py) fails a build over any of these. Measured on 28 Oct 2026 on an office laptop (DirectX 12 GPU): startup 1.5 s, idle 212 MB in use (486 MB reserved, mostly by the graphics driver), idle CPU 0, typing 17-33 ms, 2 million cells open in 3.6 s using 371 MB, scrolling them 27 ms per frame, 0-10 MB kept after closing. CI runners draw in software (no GPU), so frame and start times there are slower: the budgets leave room for that. Raise a budget only with a reason written here.

exe_mb.why: the app is 37 MB; a jump means a dependency or asset bloated it

startup_ms.why: 1.5 s on a laptop; a software-rendered CI runner is slower

idle_cpu_ms_per_10s.why: 0 on a laptop: the window draws only when something changes

open_big_ms.why: 3.6 s for 2 million cells on a laptop

scroll_frame_ms.why: 27 ms on a laptop GPU; CI draws in software

leak_after_close_mb.why: memory not given back after closing the big workbook (0-10 MB on a laptop)
